description: This file contains LESS mixins for styling form validation states, focus states, and sizing configurations used for styling form controls within Bootstrap.

methods.name: form-control-validation
methods.description: A mixin that styles form controls and labels based on validation states, applying colors, borders, and shadows.

methods.name: form-control-focus
methods.description: A mixin to generate focus styles for form controls, with customizable border and shadow colors.

methods.name: input-size
methods.description: A mixin to adjust size, padding, font size, line height, and border-radius for form inputs.
